summary: First-party executable Provider plugin for Google AI Studio and Google Cloud Agent Platform generation.
context_hints: The Provider id is clash.google; keep its declaration in providers/google.json
Plugin code performs native upstream HTTP; service-account and API-key authentication belong in this plugin, not a Host HTTP broker
Read and write only the Host-selected account state through context.store

subdirectories.providers: Google Provider declaration and account authentication forms.
subdirectories.src: Typed stdio entrypoint, Google adapter, authentication, and model-path logic.

key_files.manifest.json: Versioned executable package and contribution declarations.
key_files.providers/google.json: Provider metadata, executor link, and supported authentication methods.
key_files.src/google-adapter.ts: Native Google request and response translation.
key_files.src/model-path.ts: Model path construction for the supported Google API surfaces.
